notes: Primary rapid communication (Appl. Phys. A) with the authors' own H2 uptake measurements at 77 K and 0-1 bar on 21 carbonaceous and 15 oxidic sorbents. The text does not use the word volumetric, but the H2 uptake is measured on a Micromeritics ASAP 2010 (a static gas-dosing physisorption analyser) and reported as ml (STP)/g, so I1 is judged met as a volumetric measurement; the paper does not name the method, so a stricter reading of I1 could differ. Table 1 gives SBET for every carbon sample, with N2 at 77 K (ASAP 2400). Not a review or thesis; no retraction (record is_retracted false, no retraction notice in the text); the paper states no earlier publication of its H2 values (the survey cites earlier work only for context).
